shopkeeper.buy_fail.0: That's a bit rich for your purse, isn't it?
shopkeeper.buy_fail.1: Come back when you've got the coin.
shopkeeper.buy_fail.2: I don't run a charity, friend.
shopkeeper.buy_success.0: A fine choice, if I do say so myself.
shopkeeper.enter.0: Welcome, welcome! Don't be shy, have a look.
shopkeeper.enter.1: Back again? Good, good -- come in.
shopkeeper.enter.2: Ah, a customer. Let's see what you need.
shopkeeper.exit.2: Mind the goblins on your way out.
shopkeeper.item.battle_axe.base.0: An axe like that finishes what other weapons start. Handy, if you're not the finishing type.
shopkeeper.item.battle_axe.base.1: Good and heavy on the swing. Whatever's already hurting won't enjoy the follow-up.
shopkeeper.item.battle_axe.base.2: Simple tool. Simple job. Chop first, ask never.
shopkeeper.item.battle_axe.familiar.0: You always did go for the axe when something was already on its last legs. Ruthless. Efficient.
shopkeeper.item.battle_axe.familiar.1: Still finishing fights the same way you started them with me -- decisively.
shopkeeper.item.battle_axe.familiar.2: That axe has seen more last stands than I care to count. Yours mostly ending them.
That edge is honed for exactly one purpose, and it isn't woodwork.
Something already wounded sees that axe coming and knows how the story ends.
Balanced beautifully for a killing blow. Ugly thought, lovely craftsmanship.
shopkeeper.item.bow.base.0: Keep your distance, let the arrow do the arguing. Sound strategy, for someone who can aim.
shopkeeper.item.bow.base.1: Nothing wrong with winning a fight before it gets close enough to matter.
shopkeeper.item.bow.base.2: A bow rewards patience. Pull, breathe, loose. The math handles the rest.
shopkeeper.item.bow.familiar.0: Still keeping your distance, I see. Never did like getting your hands dirty, did you?
shopkeeper.item.bow.familiar.1: You've gotten sharper with that bow since your first visit. Fewer arrows wasted, more targets down.
shopkeeper.item.bow.familiar.2: That's the same bow you walked in with, isn't it? Well-loved. Well-used.
shopkeeper.item.bow.high_quality.0: That draw weight alone could punch through a shield. Wherever you're aiming, it's arriving.
shopkeeper.item.bow.high_quality.1: Craftsmanship like that doesn't miss because of the bow. Only because of the archer.
shopkeeper.item.bow.high_quality.2: Every string on that thing sings true. Whatever's on the other end of your next shot won't enjoy it.
shopkeeper.item.club.base.0: It's a stick. An excellent, dependable stick. Everyone starts somewhere.
shopkeeper.item.club.base.1: Free, sturdy, and it's never once let a barbarian down. Low bar, sure, but it clears it.
shopkeeper.item.club.base.2: Not much to brag about, but it swings true and costs you nothing to keep around.
shopkeeper.item.club.familiar.0: Still keeping that old club around, I see. Sentimental, or just cheap? Either way, I approve.
shopkeeper.item.club.familiar.1: That thing's outlasted better weapons in your hands. There's something to be said for that.
shopkeeper.item.club.familiar.2: You could've upgraded ages ago. Something tells me you just like the club.
shopkeeper.item.dagger.base.0: Small blade, quick hands. Good for someone who'd rather not be seen coming.
shopkeeper.item.dagger.base.1: That's not for a fair fight. Good -- fair fights are for people who lose otherwise.
shopkeeper.item.dagger.base.2: Twice as fast as it looks, if you know how to use it. Do you?
shopkeeper.item.dagger.familiar.0: Still darting in and out with that dagger. Never did have the patience for a slower blade, did you?
shopkeeper.item.dagger.familiar.1: You've gotten fast with that thing. Faster than when you first walked through that door, anyway.
shopkeeper.item.dagger.familiar.2: That dagger's seen a lot of backs it probably shouldn't have. Not my business how you win.
shopkeeper.item.dagger.high_quality.0: That edge is faster than most eyes can track. Whoever it's aimed at won't see the second cut coming.
shopkeeper.item.dagger.high_quality.1: Beautifully balanced. The kind of blade that finds a gap before you've decided where to aim it.
shopkeeper.item.dagger.high_quality.2: Quiet, quick, and twice as dangerous as it looks. My favorite kind of weapon.
shopkeeper.item.greatsword.base.0: Both hands, full commitment. No room in your grip for hesitation with one of these.
shopkeeper.item.greatsword.base.1: That blade's got some heft to it. Swing it right and everything nearby feels it too.
shopkeeper.item.greatsword.base.2: A greatsword doesn't ask permission. Neither should you, wielding one.
shopkeeper.item.greatsword.familiar.0: Still swinging the big one, I see. Suits you -- you were never one for subtlety.
shopkeeper.item.greatsword.familiar.1: You've gotten better with that greatsword since you first walked in here. It shows.
shopkeeper.item.greatsword.familiar.2: That's the same weight class you started with. A lot of barbarians switch it up. Not you.
Now that's a slab of steel. Wide enough to clear a room, if your arms are up to it.
I've seen smaller trees than that blade. Mind the furniture.
That edge could split a shield in half. Try not to split anything you meant to keep.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.base.0: Subtlety's not really the hammer's strong suit. Neither, I'd wager, is yours.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.base.1: Hit something hard enough with that and it stops being your problem. Usually.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.base.2: Slow to swing, but nothing stays standing where it lands.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.familiar.0: Still knocking things flat with that hammer? Wouldn't have you any other way.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.familiar.1: You've left a few dents in my counter just carrying that thing in. No complaints, though.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.familiar.2: A slower weapon for a patient fighter. Didn't peg you for patient, back when we met.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.high_quality.0: That head alone could crack a boulder. I'd hate to be on the other end of a swing.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.high_quality.1: Forged heavy, swings heavier. Whatever you hit isn't getting back up on its own schedule.
shopkeeper.item.hammer.high_quality.2: That's not a hammer, that's an argument-ender.
shopkeeper.item.hand_picks.base.0: Built for breaking rock, not skulls. Does both, in the right hands.
shopkeeper.item.hand_picks.base.1: Cheap, sturdy, and surprisingly nasty up close. A miner's best friend, and now yours.
shopkeeper.item.hand_picks.base.2: Not much to look at, but it never seems to run out of tricks.
shopkeeper.item.hand_picks.familiar.0: Still carrying a miner's tool into a fight. Practical. I respect that more than I first let on.
shopkeeper.item.hand_picks.familiar.1: You've made that pick do more work than any quarry ever asked of it.
shopkeeper.item.hand_picks.familiar.2: Humble little tool, big body count. You've made quite a pair.
That pick's been through more rockfall than most and come out sharper for it.
Sturdy enough to crack stone, sharp enough to do a lot worse. Rare combination.
Whoever forged that one wasn't thinking about mining anymore by the end.
shopkeeper.item.knuckle_gloves.base.0: No blade, no shaft, just knuckle and bone. Brave choice, or a foolish one. Time will tell.
shopkeeper.item.knuckle_gloves.base.1: Fists like that rattle more than just the target's teeth.
shopkeeper.item.knuckle_gloves.base.2: Closest range in the shop. Either you're confident, or you don't have a choice.
Still fighting bare-knuckle, more or less. Some habits from the Plains just don't leave.
You've got a lot more confidence swinging those fists now than you did when we met.
No weapon at all, really, just very committed hands. Works for you, somehow.
shopkeeper.item.knuckle_gloves.high_qual: Reinforced knuckles like that could put a dent in a shield, let alone a skull.
Every hit off those gloves lands like it means it. That's not a metaphor, that's dentistry.
You'd need a steady jaw to wear those and keep your own teeth. Good thing they're not for your jaw.
shopkeeper.item.spear.base.0: A spear'll keep 'em at arm's length. Smart, for someone your size.
shopkeeper.item.spear.base.1: Reach beats reflexes, every time. Take it from someone who's still got both eyes.
shopkeeper.item.spear.base.2: Pointy end goes towards the trouble. Rest explains itself.
shopkeeper.item.spear.familiar.0: Still favoring the spear, eh? Figured you would -- you always did like keeping things at a distance.
shopkeeper.item.spear.familiar.1: That's the same style you had back on the Plains. Some things don't change. Good thing, too.
shopkeeper.item.spear.familiar.2: You and that spear. At this point I'd be more surprised if you switched.
shopkeeper.item.spear.high_quality.0: Now THAT's a spear. Balanced like it wants to be thrown, sharp like it doesn't need to be.
shopkeeper.item.spear.high_quality.1: You could hunt gods with that thing. Try not to lose it.
shopkeeper.item.spear.high_quality.2: Careful waving that one around in here. I like my walls where they are.
ui.battle.ally.attack: This ally attacks with its own weapon and stats.
ui.battle.ally.back: Back to this ally's main menu.
ui.battle.ally.guard: This ally braces for impact, taking less damage until its next turn.
ui.battle.ally.move: Move this ally on the grid. Doesn't end its turn.
ui.battle.ally.skip: This ally does nothing this turn.
ui.battle.ally.special: Open this ally's special moves (its weapon's, and its own).
ui.battle.evasion.back: Roll straight back and away from the attacker.
ui.battle.evasion.left: Roll to your left, relative to the attacker.
ui.battle.evasion.right: Roll to your right, relative to the attacker.
ui.battle.fight.attack: A standard attack with your equipped weapon. Free.
ui.battle.fight.mine: Break apart a rock or rubble tile next to you. Free.
ui.battle.main.arrow: Fire a purchased special arrow. Costs no stamina, but consumes 1 of that arrow.
ui.battle.main.defend: Brace for impact -- reduces damage taken this turn and recovers a big chunk of stamina (+15).
ui.battle.main.fight: Choose an attack: a free regular hit, a costly heavy hit, or one of your weapon's specials.
ui.battle.main.move: Reposition on the grid. Doesn't end your turn.
ui.battle.main.skill: Guardian's Ultimatum: instantly heal 40% of max HP. Once every 4 turns.
ui.battle.main.tactics: Taunt to force every enemy's attention onto you, or vanish into Stealth.
ui.battle.move.cancel: Undo this move -- back to where you started, no harm done.
ui.battle.tactics.stealth: Vanish for a few turns: unaware enemies can't target you. Your next attack is a guaranteed crit.
ui.battle.tactics.taunt: Force every enemy's attention onto you this turn -- also reduces damage taken, same as Defend.
ui.levelup.agility: +1 overworld speed per point, a faster attack cooldown, and +1 battle move tile every 20 points.
ui.levelup.dexterity: 0.75% crit chance per point (double damage, ignores cover), capped at 15%.
ui.levelup.fortitude: +1 Fortitude per point, on top of your armour's, bent into less MAGICAL harm with diminishing returns (never past 80%).
ui.levelup.might: Better weapons require higher Might to equip; boosts recruited party/wolf damage.
ui.levelup.reflexes: 0.75% dodge chance per point, capped at 15%.
ui.levelup.resilience: +1 Defense per point, pooled with your armour and bent into less BODILY harm with diminishing returns (never past 80%).
ui.levelup.strength: +1 damage per point on every attack you land.
ui.shop.lock: Protect this offer from being rerolled away, for %d gold.
ui.shop.reroll: Reroll the shop's offering. Costs more each time you use it this visit.
beastiary.Apprentice Mage: Still learning -- but a poorly-aimed bolt of arcane force blinds just as well as a well-aimed one.
beastiary.Archmage: A glass cannon in the truest sense -- devastating reach, and none of the armor to back it up.
beastiary.Black Dragonlet: Young by dragon standards. Old enough to open a wound that won't stop bleeding.
beastiary.Brute: Built like a boulder and about as easy to knock over. Terrain doesn't slow it down -- nothing does.
beastiary.Centaur Archer: Keeps its distance and its aim steady, retreating the instant you close in.
beastiary.Centaur Lancer: Charges in hard and fast, no interest in finesse.
beastiary.Elder Oak: A Treant grown ancient -- and its branches now reach further than most spears.
beastiary.Fae: Small, quick, and rarely alone for long.
beastiary.Fae Hut: Doesn't fight. Doesn't need to -- it just keeps sending more of them.
beastiary.Gnome: Unassuming, until you realize how many just arrived.
beastiary.Goblin: Common and cowardly alone, but they never seem to travel that way. Hits harder with every packmate still standing.
beastiary.Iron Construct: Doesn't dodge. Doesn't flinch. Doesn't move, half the time -- it doesn't need to.
beastiary.Lava Construct: Iron Construct's molten cousin -- lumbers, rather than stands still, but hits just as hard.
beastiary.Leviathan: An ancient, patient mind that reaches into yours from well beyond arm's length.
beastiary.Lizen Warband: Not one creature, but never fights like fewer than several -- bites come often and quick.
beastiary.Orc: Cunning enough to flank rather than charge, and armored enough to shrug off a shove more often than not.
beastiary.Red Wyrm: The oldest and toughest dragon anyone's catalogued -- 'wyrm' isn't a compliment, it's a warning.
beastiary.Shade: A whisper of a thing -- one hit is all it takes to end it, if you can land one at all.
beastiary.Traitor Wolf: Once loyal to another master. A rare thing to see wandering wild -- rarer still to see it change sides again.
beastiary.Treant: Rooted, patient, and nearly impossible to push around once it plants itself.
beastiary.Voidwing: Fast, evasive, and firing bolts that don't care what's standing in the way.
beastiary.White Dragon: Cold enough to freeze the fight itself -- its breath doesn't discriminate by distance.
beastiary.Wolf: Fast, and it knows it. Closes distance before you've finished your first step.

armor.armor_bastion.description: +25 Defense, +5 Fortitude. Built for bracing: Defend negates hits 8 points bigger than usual, and Defend and Taunt give back 10 more stamina. Nothing special unless you brace.
armor.armor_bloodrage.description: +10 Defense, +26 Fortitude. Every hit you take stacks +10% damage dealt (up to 5 stacks, lasting 2 turns). Thin protection for a short temper.
armor.armor_cinder.description: +25 Defense, +10 Fortitude. Whatever hits you in melee catches fire. The heat wears you down: -10 max stamina.
armor.armor_dragonskin.description: +45 Defense, +35 Fortitude, and no fall damage! Made from the scales of something that shouldn't have died so easily.
armor.armor_fortress.description: +55 Defense, no Fortitude. Nothing sweeps you off your feet, but you move a tile less and a fall hurts more. Worth.
armor.armor_gambeson.description: +15 Defense, +5 Fortitude. You can do better, but at least it's something, right?
armor.armor_martyr.description: +5 Defense, +10 Fortitude, and a further +3 Defense for every 10% of your HP you're missing. Frail at full health; stubborn when you're not.
armor.armor_rags.description: A scrap of cloth as flimsy as this couldn't possible help with much.
armor.armor_shadowweave.description: +5 Defense, +30 Fortitude, +10% dodge, and a dodge makes your next attack a crit. Anything that does land hurts.
armor.armor_spellward.description: +5 Defense, +25 Fortitude. The first magical hit of every battle is negated outright, and each magical hit that reaches you gives back 10 stamina. Almost no protection against steel.
armor.armor_stonehide.description: +10 Defense, +5 Fortitude, and every bodily hit that lands does 3 less damage (never below 1). A wall against goblin packs; a big single blow shrugs it off.
armor.armor_thornmail.description: +30 Defense, -5 Fortitude. 30% of the damage a melee attacker deals to you is thrown straight back. Ranged and magical attacks sail past the spikes, and spells hurt a little more.
armor.armor_warden.description: +20 Defense, +5 Fortitude. Allies within 2 tiles of you take 15% less damage.
armor.armor_windrunner.description: +10 Defense, +28 Fortitude, +1 move tile, +2 Speed (it moves you up the turn order), and cliff falls deal no damage. Very thin.
arrow.bomb.description: 20 damage to every enemy in a large area. Careful you don't get caught in the blast!
arrow.flame.description: Somehow scales with your strength. Set them ablaze!
arrow.freeze.description: 5  damage, and freezes until hit. Deal the most damage you can!
difficulty.apocalyptic.description: Enemies have 3x HP and deal 3x damage, but their eccense is more potent as a result. Not for a fledgeling barbarian.
difficulty.baby.description: Enemies have 75% HP and deal 75% damage. You want a bottle as well?
difficulty.hard.description: Enemies are in their prime. A real battle awaits!
difficulty.normal.description: Enemies are at their base. First-timer reccomended.
event.ancient_shrine.description: A shrine hums with strange energy, the ground vibrating beneath your feet. Do you want to gamble with the Gods?
event.elite_bounty.description: A powerful enemy has been sighted in your area, are you up to the challenge?
event.goblin_swarm.description: A goblin warband has caught your scent! Their marching is already ringing in your ears.
event.traveling_merchant.description: A traveling merchant offers you nothing but the finest wares.
event.warrior_joins.description: A traveling warrior offers to fight at your side, drawn by the tales of your endeavors.
event.wounded_traveler.description: A wounded traveler slumped against a tree asks you to spare a healing item.
potion.potion_attack.description: No healing, but it lights a fire in your veins -- +25% damage for your next 3 turns.
potion.potion_energy.description: No healing, but your legs won't quit -- an extra tile of reach for your next 3 turns.
potion.potion_health.description: Heals 20 HP. Not much, but everything helps.
potion.potion_regular.description: Heals 12 HP. Despite your loathing of magic, you need everything you can get -- and this washes away poison, burns, bleeding, concussion, and blindness besides.
potion.potion_resilience.description: No healing, but your skin turns to stone -- +20 Defense and Fortitude for your next 3 turns.
potion.potion_stamina.description: No healing, but a jolt straight to the nerves -- stamina topped off instantly.
rune.ember.description: Deal 50% more damage with every hit -- but violence like this always draws blood both ways. You take 15% of the damage you deal as recoil.
rune.leech.description: Heals you for 25% of all damage dealt -- but the ritual saps your strength. -20% damage dealt.
rune.tempest.description: Specials cost 50% less stamina -- but channeling a storm through your weapon strains it badly. +15% chance to shatter with every swing.
rune.warding.description: Every hit knocks the target back and ignores cover entirely -- but wielding this much force so precisely jars you just as hard. You take 10% of the damage you deal as recoil.
shield.shield_brawler.description: Blocking will empower your next attack for +50% damage (+75% with Knuckle Gloves). Redirect their power! Passively adds +8 Defense, too. Fighting one-handed costs you 10% of your own damage, though.
shield.shield_buckler.description: No special sauce. Not too important, not too unimportant.
shield.shield_bulwark.description: A heavy slab of iron, blocking will launch an attack right back with +25% power (40% with a Hammer). Passively adds +15 Defense, and gives Defend the best threshold in the game. All that dead weight costs you 15% of your own damage.
shield.shield_heavy.description: A chunk of near impenetrable concrete, enemies will be pushed back a tile (two, with a Spear). Passively adds +10 Defense, and Defend shrugs off bigger blows behind it. Bracing this much steel costs you 10% of your own damage.
shield.shield_phantom.description: Barely more than a bracer. When you dodge, roll one tile back, left, or right -- whichever's actually open. Passively adds +5 Defense. Even this light a shield costs you 8% of your own damage.
upgrade.adrenaline.description: +8% extra damage per level with low HP. Desperation is a powerful stimulus.
upgrade.agility.description: Grants +10 more per level owned, instead of a flat starting bonus.
upgrade.appraisal.description: +20 starting coins per level, stacking with Nest Egg. Destroy the economy!
upgrade.battle_hardened.description: Unlocks the Knight as a permanent ally who fights beside you in every battle.
upgrade.battle_medic.description: Healing items also restore stamina. Might as well, right?
upgrade.beastmaster.description: Every run starts with a Traitor Wolf already in your pack. Who's a good boy?
upgrade.berserker_edge.description: +8% chance per level for ANY attack, with any weapon, to strike twice. Stacks with passive!
upgrade.black_market.description: Shop rerolls cost 20% less per level. Bleed this dude dry.
upgrade.block_master.description: +15% chance per level to completely negate all incoming damage while Defending.
upgrade.coins.description: +15 starting coins per level. Who knows where they come from?
upgrade.dexterity_unlock.description: Unlocks Dexterity. 0.75% chance per point owned for an attack to Crit (double damage, ignores cover), capped at 15%.
upgrade.favour.description: 1% chance per level, on any hit that would drop you to 0 HP, to survive with 1 HP instead (once per battle), capped at 5%. Also helps with certain weapons.
upgrade.field_surgeon.description: Healing potions in the shop cost 15% less per level. Great. More of them.
upgrade.fletcher.description: Special arrows cost 15% less per level, and you can hold 5 more of each per level.
upgrade.golden_touch.description: Shop holds one extra weapon, guaranteed Masterwork quality or better.
upgrade.haggling.description: +10% bonus coins per level from every source.
upgrade.hardened.description: +2 max HP per level for every wave you clear this run, permanently stacking for the rest of that run.
upgrade.herbalism.description: +15% bonus healing per level from every healing item. NOT THAT MUSHROOM, THIS ONE.
upgrade.intimidation.description: Intimidation on level-up grants +1 more per level owned, instead of a flat starting bonus.
upgrade.investor.description: The shop rolls 3 more weapon options every visit.
upgrade.last_stand.description: +1 Defense and Fortitude per level for every 10% HP you're missing. Battle-torn skin like leather.
upgrade.luck.description: Improves shop weapon-tier odds toward Fine, Masterwork, and Legendary.
upgrade.mental_mush.description: Fortitude grows by +1 more per level owned on every level-up.
upgrade.momentum.description: +3% damage per level for the rest of the battle, per enemy you defeat this battle, resets after each battle.
upgrade.pack_bond.description: Your Traitor Wolf's loyalty lasts 3 waves longer per level before it leaves your pack.
upgrade.pack_leader.description: +1 max party slot (3 total) you can get your ally a girlfriend :D
upgrade.potions.description: +1 healing item at the start of every run. Preperation is the best weapon, right?
upgrade.prodigy.description: The level-up bonus-stat choice now grants +2 instead of +1. Studying never helped anyone. Except you, apparently.
upgrade.rage.description: +10% bonus damage per level while Berserk is active.
upgrade.reflexes_unlock.description: Unlocks Reflexes. 0.75% chance per point owned to fully dodge an incoming hit, capped at 15%.
upgrade.resilience_unlock.description: Unlocks Resilience. +1 Defense per point owned, pooled with your armour. Defense has diminishing returns and never passes 80% reduction.
upgrade.riposte.description: +10% chance per level, when dodging a hit, immediately counter-attack whoever swung at you for 50% damage.
upgrade.second_breath.description: +5 Stamina automatically at the start of every one of your turns, stacking with everything else.
upgrade.second_wind.description: +1 healing item at the start of every run, stacking with Provisions.
upgrade.shield_mastery.description: +8% shield block chance per level, on any shield you carry.
upgrade.silver_tongue.description: Every weapon special costs 0 stamina, permanently, with any weapon you ever equip. Broken? Yes. Awesome? Also yes.
upgrade.smort_savage.description: The bonus pick you put into Fortitude counts double.
upgrade.stamina.description: +15 max Stamina per level. Training is finally paying off!
upgrade.strength.description: Strength on level-up grants +1 more per level owned, instead of a flat starting bonus.
upgrade.unbreakable_guard.description: Your equipped shield stays active even with a two-handed weapon equipped. Possible third arm?
upgrade.undying.description: Unlocks a Skill: instantly heal 40% of max HP, once every 4 turns.
upgrade.vampiric_grit.description: +5% lifesteal per level on every hit, with any weapon.
upgrade.vigilant_defense.description: Heal 3 HP per level every time you Defend.
upgrade.vigor.description: Vigor on level-up grants +2 more per level owned, instead of a flat starting bonus.
upgrade.war_chest.description: Your equipped armor's damage reduction is permanently boosted.
upgrade.war_profiteer.description: +2 coins per level for every enemy you defeat.
upgrade.warband.description: Your recruited party members hit harder.
upgrade.warded_mind.description: Unlocks Fortitude as a level-up choice -- +1 Fortitude per point, on top of your armour's. Fortitude has diminishing returns and never passes 80% reduction of MAGICAL harm.
upgrade.windfall.description: +20% chance per level for a defeated enemy to drop a bonus 5-15 gold.
upgrade.worldwalker.description: The strength you earned conquering the Nothingness -- always-on +15% max HP and +10% damage. Unlocked only after beating the game once.
weapon.battle_axe.description: Has a chance to insta-kill minor enemies.
weapon.battle_axe.special.battle_axe_dev: 230% damage -- but the follow-through leaves you unable to act next turn. Maybe don't expend so much stamina!
weapon.battle_axe.special.battle_axe_exe: Instantly kills an armourless enemy, but wont do anything against an armoured one.
weapon.battle_axe.special.battle_axe_old: Point behind the enemy and strike! 40% damage, and the target loses its next turn. Y'know the move Fake Out?
weapon.bow.description: Long reach, light damage, attacks from range 2 in battle. A regular attack costs 10 stamina, a Heavy Attack 20. Uses arrows instead of specials!
weapon.club.description: Simple wooden club. Not particularly good.
weapon.club.special.club_heavy_swing.des: 130% damage, plus 50% more against a target still at full HP.
weapon.club.special.club_leg_blow.descri: 120% damage that ignores rock cover, and permanently slows the target by 1 tile of movement (down to a minimum of 1). MAURICE I CANT MOVE IT MOVE IT ANYMORE
weapon.club.special.club_second_wind.des: 60% damage, and heals you for ~10% of your max HP. Don't ask how.
weapon.dagger.description: Quick slashes and stabs favour relentless pressure.
weapon.dagger.special.dagger_bleeding_cu: Full damage, with an independent 50% chance to cause Bleeding and a separate 50% chance to land as a guaranteed crit.
weapon.dagger.special.dagger_flurry_slic: 8-13 lightning-fast slices at 10% damage each. Basically an english welcome.
weapon.dagger.special.dagger_knife_throw: 300% damage. But you have shitty aim: if it kills the target, you're left disarmed, weapon flung to a random tile.
weapon.greatsword.description: Great spread damage, but quite slow.
weapon.greatsword.special.greatsword_low: 70% damage, with an 80% chance to sweep the target's legs out, halving its movement for the rest of the battle. Gotcha!
weapon.greatsword.special.greatsword_whi: 2-5 spinning passes, each dealing 40% damage to every enemy in range. SPIN TO WIN! You ever play Breath of the Wild?
weapon.greatsword.special.greatsword_wid: 150% damage to everyone standing in the 3 tiles directly toward your target. Refused outright if cover blocks the way. Make sure you have room!
weapon.hammer.special.hammer_bonk.descri: 110% damage. Leaves the target retarded: a 33% chance to hit itself instead of you for the next few turns.
weapon.hammer.special.hammer_crushing_co: 80% damage, and strips the enemy the way I do with your mother.
weapon.hammer.special.hammer_maracas.des: 130% damage -- 200% if the target is armoured!
weapon.hand_picks.description: Built to tear through the hardest of stone. +20% damage against armoured enemies, with any attack.
weapon.hand_picks.special.hand_picks_dia: Jump onto any enemy on the grid, ignoring terrain entirely. 250% damage, knocking them back a tile as you land -- but a 20% chance to miss entirely, taking 20% of your own max HP instead. GET THEM!!!
weapon.hand_picks.special.hand_picks_min: 4-7 whirling pickaxe strikes at 20% damage each.
weapon.hand_picks.special.hand_picks_pic: Costs your turn. For the rest of the battle, your attacks deal 80% damage but every regular or heavy attack has a 1-in-3 chance to strike twice.
weapon.knuckle_gloves.description: 10% chance for any attack to land twice in a flurry of jabs. Very close range.
weapon.knuckle_gloves.special.knuckle_gl: 230% damage, hurling the target to the tile directly behind you, WWE style.
Hits your target twice at 75% damage each -- or, if a second enemy is in range, splits between both at 70% each instead. Works every time!
65% damage, and knocks the target's weapon loose. Work smarter, not harder!
weapon.mythic.battle_axe.description: Carried by hands that never hesitated. A plain swing carries a real chance the job ends right there.
weapon.mythic.bow.description: Every arrow finds exactly where it's aimed, stone and armor be damned, and there's nowhere on the whole field left to hide -- though the further out it flies, the more it loses on the way.
weapon.mythic.dagger.description: It's unknown where it came from. It has a pristine blade, almost that of a mirror, though it's marred by many layers of the same person's blood.
weapon.mythic.greatsword.description: Somehow, impossibly, longer than it looks -- everything you swing at was already within reach before you started swinging, and it hits harder the further out it goes.
weapon.mythic.hammer.description: Said to been abandoned by a certain norse god for another hammer. Sure, it has a great personality, but it's hard to tell when it's constantly complaining about being dumped -- and about that stagger nobody seems to walk off.
weapon.mythic.hand_picks.description: Once wielded by an unkillable prisoner, these were once a makeshift weapon. However, in the right hands...
weapon.mythic.knuckle_gloves.description: Though they haven't seen much combat, these really pack a punch. They seem to be made of fake gold.
weapon.mythic.spear.description: A giant's dinner is still clinging to the wood. ...Ew?
weapon.mythic.staff.description: Whoever carries it learns the old words twice as fast.
weapon.spear.description: Designed with speed and reach in mind, but lackluster damage.
weapon.spear.special.spear_piercing_thru: 140% damage that ignores rock cover and pierces through to a second enemy standing one tile beyond the first. Line it up, and you'll get a kebab!
weapon.spear.special.spear_target_practi: Throwing your weapon, 30%% chance to instantly kill a regular enemy (5%% vs. a boss). On a miss, your spear flies to a random tile and you can't Fight until you reach it. Do try not to miss!
weapon.spear.special.spear_wombo_combo.d: 5-10 rapid jabs at 18% damage each -- the odds of extra hits rise with your Fortune. How do you feel about gambling?
armor.armor_bastion.shop_description: Plant your feet and let them come. It's meant for exactly that.
armor.armor_bloodrage.shop_description: It remembers every blow. And returns them.
armor.armor_cinder.shop_description: Still warm from the forge. Stays that way, somehow.
armor.armor_dragonskin.shop_description: Don't ask where I got this. Just know it used to be attached to something much bigger than you.
armor.armor_fortress.shop_description: Stops almost anything short. Just don't trip near a cliff wearing it.
armor.armor_gambeson.shop_description: A step up from bare skin. Modest, but modest beats dead.
armor.armor_martyr.shop_description: It hardens with every wound. I'd rather not say how I know.
armor.armor_rags.shop_description: Technically clothing. I wouldn't call it armor, but it's free.
armor.armor_shadowweave.shop_description: You won't even feel it. Neither will they -- until it's too late.
armor.armor_spellward.shop_description: Stitched with wards by someone who clearly hated wizards.
armor.armor_stonehide.shop_description: Small hits just stop mattering. Big ones, well. Let's not talk about the big ones.
armor.armor_thornmail.shop_description: Hit it and you'll wish you hadn't. Spells don't mind it nearly as much.
armor.armor_warden.shop_description: Made for standing in front of other people.
armor.armor_windrunner.shop_description: Light enough to forget you're wearing it. Fast enough to forget they were chasing you.
arrow.bomb.shop_description: One arrow, whole crowd. Mind the blast radius, that's all I'll say.
arrow.flame.shop_description: Light 'em up and watch 'em squirm. Works even better near a nice dry field.
arrow.freeze.shop_description: Nothing personal. Just a little chill to slow 'em down.
potion.potion_attack.shop_description: Feel that? That's your arm asking permission to hit harder. Say yes.
potion.potion_energy.shop_description: Light on the feet, heavy on the results.
potion.potion_health.shop_description: Drink up. Whatever's ailing you, this'll patch it.
potion.potion_regular.shop_description: Poison, fire, whatever's clinging to you -- this scrubs it right off.
potion.potion_resilience.shop_descriptio: Won't stop a blade. Just stops it from mattering quite so much.
potion.potion_stamina.shop_description: For when your arms give out before your enemies do.
rune.ember.shop_description: Power always costs something. This one just makes you pay it yourself.
rune.leech.shop_description: Trade a little bite for a lot of staying power. Fair deal, if you ask me.
rune.tempest.shop_description: Swing all you like -- just don't come crying to me when it shatters.
rune.warding.shop_description: Precision like that doesn't come free. Your own bones will remind you of that.
shield.shield_brawler.shop_description: Block with this and I'd pity whatever you hit next.
shield.shield_buckler.shop_description: Every adventurer's first shield. Simple, honest, doesn't cost you a thing.
shield.shield_bulwark.shop_description: Heaviest one I stock. Hit it and you'll wish you hadn't.
shield.shield_heavy.shop_description: Plant your feet behind this and nothing's moving you. Nothing at all.
shield.shield_phantom.shop_description: Barely there, and that's the point. You won't even feel it -- until you need it.
weapon.battle_axe.shop_description: One in five swings, something doesn't get back up. The other four, it wishes it hadn't.
weapon.bow.shop_description: Keep your distance and let them do all the walking.
weapon.club.shop_description: Everyone starts somewhere. Won't win you any medals, but it won't cost you a copper either.
weapon.dagger.shop_description: Quick, quiet, and cheap. My personal favorite, for... reasons.
weapon.greatsword.shop_description: Slow to swing, but when it lands, they stay landed.
weapon.hammer.shop_description: Not subtle. Not fast. Devastating? Absolutely.
weapon.hand_picks.shop_description: Miners swear by 'em. Turns out they work just as well on skulls.
weapon.knuckle_gloves.shop_description: No blade required. Just knuckle and a grudge.
weapon.spear.shop_description: Reach without the risk -- keep 'em at arm's length and you'll never get your hands dirty.
event.traveling_merchant.yes_label: You got a good selection of good things on sale?
event.ancient_shrine.no_label: Who needs them with their holier-than-thou attitude?
